Cards.Name: Poison the Cup
Cards.Text:
This Shugenja has Shadowlands.
Maho Limited, Bow this card: Remove a target token from a Personality and give him a -1C Plague token. Lose 1 Honor.

Cards.Name: Unbound Essence
Cards.Text: Limited: Bow this Shugenja, destroy this card, and target a Personality who must be non-Unique unless this Shugenja is Void: Show cards from the top of the target's controller's Dynasty deck until you show a Personality or you show all cards in the deck. If you showed a Personality, overlay him on the target.
